name: qkd_static_kv_landing_seg

pin_regs.reason: Every pin is already a flop in RTL: inputs land on the landing_pc input registers (ps_q/as_q/ae_q/al_q/ad_q/arm_q/epoch_q/layer_q/put_q/actual_q) and the rowctl request registers (rq/tq/vq/eq/lq, vrq/vtq); outputs leave the rowctl rsp_* / fault registers; cfg straps are registered in each PC (stack_q/group_q). A synthesis pin-register stage would add a second, redundant edge.

fill_reason.pin_bound: height = one landing group's 4 HBM PC pitches (4 x 378 um): PC q's 289-b return word and its SRAM sit level with the controller-strip / return-slot PC q (8 segments tile the 12,096-um stack column); width = the 94.8-um 128x256 SRAM + >= 20 um to both pin faces. Content ~4 SRAMs (15.6k um2) + ~11k flops.

slot_change_request: Q-KVSYS-STRIP 2026-10-16 (coordinator priority change via Q-KVSYS-DIE a58156848): NEW master for the die's static landing (replaces the credit-based qkd_land_strip / qkd_land_seg): 151.2 x 1,512 um, 8 per stack (32 per die) at the PC pitch, cfg_stack/cfg_group strap pins; E face = return slots / writer-calendar (actual_*, expected_*, arm/epoch/layer), W face = head request / response and the PV16 V port (req_*, vreq_*, rsp_*), clock ck on W at the middle. The die lead (Q-KVSYS-DIE, OT_KV_STATIC) binds the view.

job.purpose: KV/system die STATIC landing segment qkd_static_kv_landing_seg (= qkd_static_kv_landing_physical_grp VMAP=1 VREQ=1 with cfg strap ports and one clock): 4 PCs each with its real 128x256 SRAM, per-PC hop38/hop295 branch stages, VREQ row control; fixed-cycle (latency 8 edges), no flow control. ONE master replicated 32x.
